content.description: Two circular connector diagrams showing terminal layouts. Left connector shows S1, S2, S3, S4 terminals. Right connector shows B1 and B2 terminals.

content.text: Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between terminals B1 — S1 or S3 and B2 — S2 or S4.

content.description: ISC valve component showing electrical connections with terminals S1-S4, B1, B2 and physical valve body with battery connections shown

items.text: Apply battery voltage to terminals B1 and B2 and while repeatedly grounding S4 — S2 — S3 — S1 in sequence, check that the valve moves toward the closed position.

content.description: ISC valve component showing electrical connections with terminals S1-S4, B1, B2 and physical valve body with battery and ground connections shown

items.text: Apply battery voltage to terminals B1 and B2 and while repeatedly grounding S4 — S3 — S2 — S1 — S4 in sequence, check that the valve moves toward the open position.
